items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Come on, Quint. Don't be hard with me.

ctx.x: Did you- Oh, is this your show? No.

Come on, Quint. Don't be hard with me. Y'all being hard with me. Wait a minute. Okay, we're going to- Did you know all that? Basically, yeah. I'd figured that out. Not- not specifically all that, but almost. So, alright. I'm- So you said- So what was your first- your first instrument? Was it- Was it a drumming or was it your first real instrument? Was it Quint- uh, Fess? What was your first instrument? The first instrument that you played? That I played? Yeah. Real instrument? Instrument, yeah. Guitar. Guitar.…
Acoustic? Acoustic guitar? Not acoustic. They didn't have electric guitars then.
